title: Sheet Pan Jerk Chicken Bowls with Mango Salsa
hook: Skip the Friday takeout: jerk chicken bowls, one sheet pan, and Monday lunch is done too
benefit: Lean protein, fiber from beans and rice, vitamin C from mango
ingredients: 1/2 tsp cayenne (or 1 habanero, minced, for real heat)
1 large sweet potato (about 1 lb), cut into 1/2 inch cubes
1 tbsp olive oil for the vegetables
Juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt
3 cups cooked brown rice (1 cup dry)
1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and warmed
steps: Whisk the marinade: 2 tbsp olive oil, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, allspice, thyme, paprika, cinnamon, nutmeg, cayenne, garlic, salt and pepper. Coat the chicken and rest 15 minutes, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 425F. Toss the sweet potato, bell pepper and red onion with 1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of salt on a lined sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
Push the vegetables to the edges and lay the chicken in the middle. Roast 20 to 22 minutes, until 165F inside. Broil 2 minutes, rest 5 minutes, then slice.
While it roasts, stir the salsa: mango, cucumber, cilantro, red onion, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Build 4 bowls: brown rice, black beans, roasted vegetables, sliced chicken and a big spoon of mango salsa. Serve with lime wedges. Extra bowls keep 4 days in the fridge; pack the salsa separately.
vo_steps: Whisk oil, lime, soy, honey, allspice, thyme, paprika, cinnamon and garlic. Coat the chicken.
Oven to four twenty five. Sweet potato, pepper and onion on a sheet pan with oil. Roast ten minutes.
Add the chicken in the middle. Roast twenty minutes to one sixty five, broil two, slice.

Rice, beans, veg, chicken, salsa. Four bowls, extras keep four days.
